name: Postman
summary: API collaboration platform embedded in the workflow of software teams.
overview: Postman helps developers build, test, document, and manage APIs.
bull_case: APIs are essential infrastructure and collaborative tooling can become a team standard.
bear_case: Open-source tools and cloud platforms may narrow the paid feature set.

intelligence.description: Postman provides an API platform for designing, testing, documenting and managing APIs across software teams.
company: Postman began as a developer utility and expanded into a collaborative platform for the full API lifecycle.
Its users include individual developers and larger organizations that need standard workflows across distributed engineering teams.
intelligence.why_it_matters: APIs are core infrastructure for modern software. Postman is a useful private-market measure of whether broad developer adoption can translate into durable enterprise monetization.

changed.text: Continued expanding its platform around AI API development and enterprise collaboration.
Acquired Fern to deepen API documentation and SDK capabilities.

takeaways: Postman's bottom-up developer reach is its primary asset.
Enterprise conversion and retention determine how much of that reach can be monetized.
The last disclosed valuation remains a 2021 mark.
